responsibility: This file implements the compiler-side handling of -fdiagnostics-add-output= and -fdiagnostics-set-output=, including the small DSL used to describe diagnostic output sinks. It parses scheme-and-key/value specifications, reports option-location-aware errors through diagnostic_context, dispatches to per-scheme handlers such as text and SARIF, interprets output-specific parameters like filenames and formatting booleans/enums, opens the requested diagnostic output files or default SARIF destinations, constructs diagnostic_output_format instances, and then attaches or replaces sinks on the active diagnostic context; it also contains selftests for the argument parser and its diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/opts-diagnostic.h, which only declares diagnostic-option metadata helpers and the entry points for these options, this .cc file provides the executable implementation for the -fdiagnostics-add-output= and -fdiagnostics-set-output= option DSL: parsing scheme/key-value specifications, creating text or SARIF output sinks, opening output files, wiring them into diagnostic_context, and hosting related selftests.
